description: One Danish fiscal year: financial statements decoded from the company's XBRL annual report (Erhvervsstyrelsen): revenue (null = not published, never zero), gross result, operating result, pre-tax and net result, equity, total assets, debts, average employees, plus prior-year comparatives as published in the same filing. Amounts in the filing currency (mostly DKK); the official XBRL document URL is included. Closing date comes from list_danish_company_filings. Same form check as that tool: a sole proprietorship, an estate or an undecided CVR form returns 404, not billed, as does a number unknown to the CVR or a name under objection (GDPR art. 21). The year's entity name under objection (GDPR art. 21) is served null and counted in ecartes.opposition (block partial in provenance). Paid via x402 ($0.05 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_danish_company_filing
